champion.scope: The source family is the 18 combinations of three put modes (INSERT OR IGNORE, INSERT OR REPLACE, INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), three channel modes (main changes(), main total_changes, main+other total_changes), and presence/absence of one AFTER INSERT trigger. The predictor enumerates all 18, filters by calibration receipts, and returns a value only when all surviving candidates agree on the goal.
champion.lesson: Calibration receipts show repeated puts on the same key leave committed_sum equal to the first value and channel 2 for a single put, consistent with INSERT OR IGNORE plus a channel counting direct row changes. The predictor generalizes by simulating all family members and intersecting their predictions.
